title: French Redcurrant Tarts
description: A sweet and tangy French dessert featuring redcurrants in a flaky pastry crust.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface.
Cut out small squares of the pastry, about 3-4 inches per side.
Place a few redcurrants in the center of each square.
Fold the pastry over the fruit to form a triangle or square shape.
Brush the tops with the beaten egg.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm, dust with powdered sugar if desired.
